gloss: to beg; to ask for; to entreat

definitions.gloss: to beg; to ask for; to entreat
definitions.explanation: To earnestly request something — help, forgiveness, or mercy — from someone in a more powerful or favorable position. Literary in tone; in everyday speech replaced by {頼|たの}む or お{願|ねが}いする.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}{回|かい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乞|こ}う。
examples.english: Look forward to the next broadcast. (lit. We entreat your anticipation.)

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{敗|やぶ}れた→敗れる：12712_yabureru⟧⟦{兵|へい}→兵：29510_hei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乞|こ}うた。
examples.english: The defeated soldier begged the enemy for his life.

notes:
A literary verb appearing mostly in fixed phrases and written Japanese. Almost never used in daily conversation.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧). The object is what is requested (⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乞|こ}う).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{許|ゆる}し→許し：27401_yurushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乞|こ}う: to beg for forgiveness
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乞|こ}う: to beg for one's life
- ⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乞|こ}う: to plead for help
- ご⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乞|こ}う: please look forward to it (set TV/promotional phrase)
- ⟦ご{容赦|ようしゃ}→ご容赦：06969_goyousha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乞|こ}う: to ask for forbearance (formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask, to request — everyday verb for the same idea
- ⟦お{願|ねが}いする→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧: to request (polite) — standard polite form
- ⟦{懇願|こんがん}する→懇願する：25407_kongansuru⟧: to entreat — formal Sino-Japanese verb, similar register
